summary: The enclosure is visually coherent in the reviewed exterior views, with no obvious visible collisions or floating parts. The five detailed component-interface requirements are not verified because the committed views do not show installed reference components or the internal clearances and cable paths needed to establish fit.

checks.description: The isometric, front, and top views show a coherent, complete-looking enclosure with consistent proportions and aligned exterior structure; no obvious visible collision, detached part, or missing exterior panel is present.

evidence.description: The isometric view shows the assembled enclosure, aligned top and side panels, supported base, and continuous frame without an obvious floating or intersecting exterior part.
The front orthographic view shows a symmetric, aligned elevation with intact frame and panel structure and no obvious visible collision.
The top view shows a continuous, centered cap with consistent perimeter alignment.

checks.description: The enclosure and rear service openings are visible, and inspection identifies a motherboard tray with four insert bodies, but no 170 x 170 mm Mini-ITX reference board is shown. The images therefore do not directly establish mounting-pattern fit or usable rear-I/O alignment.

evidence.description: The isometric exterior view shows the enclosure and rear openings, but the motherboard tray and a standard Mini-ITX board are not simultaneously exposed for direct fit verification.
The front view does not reveal the motherboard mounting pattern or demonstrate rear-I/O engagement with an installed reference board.

checks.description: The side ventilation is visibly present, but the Thermalright AXP120-X67 reference envelope is not shown inside the enclosure. Neither the required cooler fit nor its intake gap to the side panel can be visually established.

evidence.description: The isometric view clearly shows a perforated side panel, but the closed enclosure hides the cooler zone and no cooler envelope is rendered for clearance comparison.
The front view provides no direct line of sight to the cooler-to-side-panel intake clearance.

checks.description: Inspection confirms dedicated GPU support objects, including a riser shelf, rear I/O frame, front support, side clamps, and riser clamp bars. However, the reviewed images do not show the approved GPU envelope, PCIe riser, or power cable, so fit, bracket engagement, riser routing, and cable-bend space are not directly verified.

evidence.description: The isometric exterior view shows rear service openings, but the GPU support system and an installed reference GPU are obscured by the enclosure panels.
The front view does not expose the rear-mounted GPU volume, PCIe riser path, or power-cable bend region.

checks.description: Inspection confirms a rear-mounted 1U PSU cradle, but the committed views do not show a 160 x 80 x 40 mm PSU reference body or its cables. AC-inlet access, airflow, retention engagement, and cable routing therefore cannot be established visually.

evidence.description: The isometric view shows enclosure ventilation and rear openings but not an installed PSU reference body within the internal cradle.
The front view does not reveal PSU retention, AC-inlet engagement, airflow spacing, or internal cable routing.

checks.description: Inspection confirms a power-button solid positioned through the upper front-panel region, supporting external placement. The supplied views do not clearly expose its operable face at review scale and do not show an internal wire path to the motherboard header, so the complete interface requirement is not verified.

evidence.description: The isometric exterior view does not clearly distinguish the power-button operating face or reveal its internal connection path.
The front view shows the exterior elevation, but it does not directly demonstrate button operability or a cable route to the motherboard header.
